VaultRewardsClaimed(address,address,uint.details: Fired in _processVaultRewards() and dependent functions, like processRewards()

params._by: an address which executed the function
params._to: an address which received a reward

params._by: an address that sent the rewards, always a vault
an address which executed the function, always a factory owner

params._user: an address to query balance for

blockNumber().details: Testing time-dependent functionality is difficult and the best way of      doing it is to override block number in helper test smart contracts

returns._0: `block.number` in mainnet, custom values in testnets (if overridden)

constructor.details: Creates/deploys an instance of the core pool

params._initBlock: initial block used to calculate the rewards
params._poolToken: token the pool operates on, for example ILV or ILV/ETH pair
params._weight: number representing a weight of the pool, actual weight fraction      is calculated as that number divided by the total pools weight and doesn't exceed one

params._depositId: zero-indexed deposit ID for the address specified
params._user: an address to query deposit for
an address to query deposit length for

returns._0: number of deposits for the given address

now256().details: Testing time-dependent functionality is difficult and the best way of      doing it is to override time in helper test smart contracts

returns._0: `block.timestamp` in mainnet, custom values in testnets (if overridden)

pendingVaultRewards(address).details: Performs calculations based on current smart contract state only,      not taking into account any additional time/blocks which might have passed

params._staker: an address to calculate vault rewards value for

returns.pending: calculated vault reward value for the given address

params._staker: an address to calculate yield rewards value for

returns._0: calculated yield reward value for the given address

processRewards(bool).details: Internally executes similar function `_processRewards` from the parent smart contract      to calculate and pay yield rewards; adds vault rewards processingCan be executed by anyone at any time, but has an effect only when      executed by deposit holder and when at least one block passes from the      previous reward processingExecuted internally when "staking as a pool" (`stakeAsPool`)When timing conditions are not met (executed too frequently, or after factory      end block), function doesn't throw and exits silently_useSILV flag has a context of yield rewards only

params._useSILV: flag indicating whether to mint sILV token as a reward or not;      when set to true - sILV reward is minted immediately and sent to sender,      when set to false - new ILV reward deposit gets created if pool is an ILV pool      (poolToken is ILV token), or new pool deposit gets created together with sILV minted      when pool is not an ILV pool (poolToken is not an ILV token)

receiveVaultRewards(uint256).details: Executed by the vault to transfer vault rewards ILV from the vault      into the poolThis function is executed only for ILV core pools

params._rewardsAmount: amount of ILV rewards to transfer into the pool

rewardToWeight(uint256,uint256).details: Converts reward ILV value to stake weight (not to be mixed with the pool weight),      applying the 10^12 multiplication on the reward      - OR -Converts reward ILV value to reward/weight if stake weight is supplied as second      function parameter instead of reward/weight

setVault(address).details: Executed only by the factory owner to Set the vault

params._vault: an address of deployed IlluviumVault instance

setWeight(uint32).details: Executed by the factory to modify pool weight; the factory is expected      to keep track of the total pools weight when updatingSet weight to zero to disable the pool

params._weight: new weight to set for the pool

stake(uint256,uint64,bool).details: Requires amount to stake to be greater than zero

params._lockUntil: stake period as unix timestamp; zero means no locking
params._useSILV: a flag indicating if previous reward to be paid as sILV

stakeAsPool(address,uint256).details: Executed internally by the pool itself (from the parent `IlluviumPoolBase` smart contract)      as part of yield rewards processing logic (`IlluviumPoolBase._processRewards` function)Executed when _useSILV is false and pool is not an ILV pool - see `IlluviumPoolBase._processRewards`

params._amount: amount to be staked (yield reward amount)
params._staker: an address which stakes (the yield reward)

sync().details: Can be executed by anyone at any time, but has an effect only when      at least one block passes between synchronizationsExecuted internally when staking, unstaking, processing rewards in order      for calculations to be correct and to reflect state progress of the contractWhen timing conditions are not met (executed too frequently, or after factory      end block), function doesn't throw and exits silently

unstake(uint256,uint256,bool).details: Requires amount to unstake to be greater than zero

params._depositId: deposit ID to unstake from, zero-indexed
params._useSILV: a flag indicating if reward to be paid as sILV

updateStakeLock(uint256,uint64,bool).details: Requires new lockedUntil value to be:      higher than the current one, and      in the future, but      no more than 1 year in the future

params.useSILV: used for _processRewards check if it should use ILV or sILV

weightToReward(uint256,uint256).details: Converts stake weight (not to be mixed with the pool weight) to      ILV reward value, applying the 10^12 division on weight

isFlashPool.details: Flag indicating pool type, false means "core pool"

poolTokenReserve.details: Pool tokens value available in the pool;      pool token examples are ILV (ILV core pool) or ILV/ETH pair (LP core pool)For LP core pool this value doesnt' count for ILV tokens received as Vault rewards      while for ILV core pool it does count for such tokens as well

vaultRewardsPerWeight.details: Used to calculate vault rewardsThis value is different from "reward per token" used in locked poolNote: stakes are different in duration and "weight" reflects that

devdoc.title: Illuvium Core Pool

balanceOf(address).notice: Returns total staked token balance for the given address

getDeposit(address,uint256).notice: Returns information on the given deposit for the given address

getDepositsLength(address).notice: Returns number of deposits for the given address. Allows iteration over deposits.

pendingVaultRewards(address).notice: Calculates current vault rewards value available for address specified

pendingYieldRewards(address).notice: Calculates current yield rewards value available for address specified

processRewards(bool).notice: Service function to calculate and pay pending vault and yield rewards to the sender

stake(uint256,uint64,bool).notice: Stakes specified amount of tokens for the specified amount of time,      and pays pending yield rewards if any

sync().notice: Service function to synchronize pool state with current time

unstake(uint256,uint256,bool).notice: Unstakes specified amount of tokens, and pays pending yield rewards if any

updateStakeLock(uint256,uint64,bool).notice: Extends locking period for a given deposit

userdoc.notice: Core pools represent permanent pools like ILV or ILV/ETH Pair pool,      core pools allow staking for arbitrary periods of time up to 1 year
